en: A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a busy, elegant avenue lined with ornate multi‑story buildings and shop awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the cobbled street, with a handcart and a decorative streetlamp visible in the foreground. In the distance, domes and towers of larger buildings rise above the rooftops. The printed caption at the top right reads "GRAZ – Herrengasse" in red letters. Additional German shop signs are visible on the façades.
